title: WHO SAID THIS: Kristen Bell captures a sister’s longing in ‘Frozen’
summary: 'Do You Want to Build a Snowman?' captures a longing to reconnect in Disney’s Frozen, turning a childhood invitation into a memorable song about loneliness and sisterhood.
